description: Shared vectors of the graph contract (RFC-0007): each case's graph (and the other deployed models an extension target needs) with the contract view and the OpenAPI 3.0 document both engines must derive (version 1.0.0, no servers). The expected values are the Java engine's, reviewed by hand; the Rust engine must match them value for value.

cases.name: typed-constants-and-math
cases.describe:
Input surface:
  input.body.a (number)
  input.body.b (number)
Output surface:
  output.body.a (number)
  output.body.b (number)
  output.body.less_than (boolean)
  output.body.message (string)
  output.body.sum (number)
Declared schema: none
